texts.zh:
在观察[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]当地人口时，我们的外派团队发现了件有趣的事情。

这里的首都大街小巷都在交头接耳着关于一位“天选之人”的事情，据说是从星间下凡实现一个古老预言，并将带领[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]走入下一个黄金时期。

我们的所有人员都记录在岗，所以究竟是谁在访问这颗行星很值得进一步调查。
texts.en:
While observing the local population of [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName], our away team have come across an interesting discovery.

The capital city is abuzz with talk of a "Chosen One" who has reportedly descended from the stars to fulfill an ancient prophecy and lead the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] into a new golden age.

All of our personnel are accounted for, so whoever it is that is visiting this planet, they are worth investigating further.

texts.zh: 我们的外派团队正在[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]深入调查所谓“天选之人”来揭开他的真面目。
texts.en: Our away team's investigation into the "Chosen One" on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has revealed their true identity.

texts.zh: 一位拿玛拉流浪汉伪装成了[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]神话的核心人物，“从星间下凡而来”。
texts.en: A Namaraian Nomad is masquerading as the central figure of the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] mythology, having "descended from the stars".

texts.zh: 一位[event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName]流浪者伪装成了[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]神话的核心人物，“从星间下凡而来”。
texts.en: A [event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName] caravaneer is masquerading as the central figure of the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] mythology, having "descended from the stars".

texts.zh:
在行星上的进一步探索中发现了他把坠毁的舰船隐藏在了一片离首都一段距离无法到达的峡谷。根据其老旧的超空间引擎型号，此人可能已经到此有些年头了。

自从落难到此，他似乎开始利用当地的迷信来牟利。他被任命为充满“天智”的统治者，心安理得地开始接受当地人的顶礼膜拜。

如果放任不管，这个骗子在行星上的存在很可能对社会的发展造成严重的影响，最好还是介入处置一下。
texts.en:
Further exploration of the planet has revealed their crashed and inoperable ship hidden in an inaccessible valley some distance away from the capital. Based on the dated model of the hyperdrives, they have been here for some time.

Since becoming marooned, they appear to have been using the local superstition to their advantage. They happily accept veneration and praise from the locals having been installed as their ruler full of "celestial knowledge".

If left unchecked, this charlatan's presence on the planet will likely have heavy consequences for the developing society. It might be best to intervene.

label.en: Expose them as the fraud they are.

texts.en: We have successfully deposed the Namaraian Nomad on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] masquerading as the "Chosen One" of the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] mythology.

texts.zh: 我们揭露了[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上那个伪装成[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]神话中“天选之人”的[event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName]。
texts.en: We have successfully deposed the [event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName] on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] masquerading as the "Chosen One" of the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] mythology.

texts.zh:
在进一步调查当地的传说之后，我们告诉他们所谓天选之人的统治阶级事实上是一位被派来欺骗他们的恶魔，将会给这个世界带来千年之久的黑暗。

我们将坠毁的舰船完全拆成了碎片，让当地人无迹可寻。然而，有些个人物品已经被发现了，该物种也窥见了超过当前理解水平的科技。
texts.en:
After researching local legends in more detail, we were able to convince the ruling class that their so-called chosen one was in fact a demon sent to deceive them and plunge the planet into a thousand years of darkness.

We successfully scrapped the crashed ship for parts, leaving no trace of it for the locals to find. However, some personal items had already been discovered and have given this species a glimpse of technology beyond their current understanding.

texts.zh:
你好[Owner.GetSpeciesName]。我们了解到你们刚刚处理了一个脱离我们舰队的拿玛拉人流氓。

你们可帮了大忙。这个误入歧途的人一直让人讨厌，他的疯狂野心给我们的旅程带来了风险。

请收下这份礼物作为感谢。
texts.en:
Greetings [Owner.GetSpeciesName]. We understand that you have dealt with a rogue Namarian who separated from our fleet.

You have done us a service. This misguided individual was a constant annoyance, their wild ambitions posing a risk to our journey.

Please, take this gift as thanks.

texts.zh:
[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]处理了我们弄丢的垃圾？你们人还怪好的！这个蠢货除了麻烦什么都造不出来。至于他说的那些鬼话？真遗憾，他这都是第五次了。真的？我们很高兴他滚蛋了。
这个你收下，这是给你们处理了个麻烦玩意儿的谢礼。一锤子买卖，非常好东西。
texts.en:
[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] dealt with the lost Racket? Very good of you! This fool caused nothing but headaches for us. His mumbo jumbo? An embarrassment. It's the fifth time this has happened. Honestly? We're glad they're gone.
Here, you take this, a gift for making the problem go away. One time deal, very good value.

texts.en: Our away team was able to gain a private audience with the "Chosen One" of [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] and offer them our services in repairing their ship and returning them to space.

texts.zh: 那个拿玛拉流浪汉急切地想要接受我们的邀请，不断辩称是在搁浅于[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的时候被误认为是神，之后因惧怕事情败露后遭到伤害而惶惶不可终日。
texts.en: The Namarain Nomad was all too eager to accept the offer, explaining that they'd been mistakenly received as a god after becoming stranded on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] and had lived in fear of being harmed if unmasked ever since.

texts.zh: 那个[event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName]急切地想要接受我们的邀请，不断辩称是在搁浅于[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的时候被误认为是神，之后因惧怕事情败露后遭到伤害而惶惶不可终日。
texts.en: The [event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName] was all too eager to accept the offer, explaining that they'd been mistakenly received as a god after becoming stranded on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] and had lived in fear of being harmed if unmasked ever since.

texts.zh:
将其送到了我们的研究站修复了舰船之后，这位充满感激的旅行者将舰船库存的一大部分东西送给了我们并向我们郑重道别。

因为其离去而造成的权利真空在[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的各个教派之间引发了一场短暂但血腥的斗争，现在也趋于平息。
texts.en:
Having transported them to our research post and repaired their ship, the grateful traveler gifted us with a large portion of their vessel's inventory before bidding us farewell.

The ensuing power vacuum created by their departure triggered a brief but brutal struggle between various religious sects on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName], which has now subsided.

summary.text:
# 可疑先知 / Suspicious Prophet

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/strange_worlds_observation_events.txt:8-418`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:195`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 每月观测事件池（on_monthly_pulse_pre_ftl_observation）权重100（总权重2860），由前超光速科技进步局势的 preftl.50（5/100每月）触发（见前超光速观测故事）；分派事件按年代、观测任务与一次性标志把关。
  The monthly observation pool (on_monthly_pulse_pre_ftl_observation) with weight 100 (of 2860), fed by preftl.50 of the pre-FTL tech-progress situation (5/100 per month; see the pre-FTL observation stories); the dispatcher checks age, observation mission and a once-only flag.
- 隐藏分派 strange_worlds.3000：需要生物起源（Biogenesis）DLC，没有进行中的观测事件链，前超光速年代在石器到文艺复兴之间，观测站所有者非灭绝型且尚未触发本事件，并且已接触游牧者（非巨型企业）或与商队主国有通信（巨型企业）。
  Hidden dispatcher strange_worlds.3000: needs the Biogenesis DLC, no ongoing observation chain, a pre-FTL age from Stone to Renaissance, an observer that is not homicidal and has not had this event, and (non-megacorp) has contacted the nomads or (megacorp) has communications with the caravaneers' country.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 3005「可疑的先知」（延迟360天）→ 3010「假先知」（180天）→ 3015「真相揭晓」（180天）→ 3025（游牧者国家）或 3030（商队家国）（90天）；3010 的另一选项 → 3020「回家」。
  3005 "Suspicious Prophet" (360-day delay) -> 3010 "False Prophet" (180 days) -> 3015 "Truth Revealed" (180 days) -> 3025 (nomad country) or 3030 (caravaneers' home country) (90 days); the other option of 3010 -> 3020 "Going Home".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 3025 与 3030 互斥；3015 与 3020 来自3010的不同选项，互斥。
  3025 and 3030 are exclusive; 3015 and 3020 come from different options of 3010 and are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 结局事件随观察者类型（巨型企业或游牧联系）而变。
  The ending varies with observer type (megacorp vs nomad contact).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：分派条件、延迟与分支。
  Checked: dispatcher conditions, delays and branches.
- 说明：占用观测事件链标志（has_ongoing_observation_event_chain）。
  Note: occupies the ongoing-observation-chain flag.
